verdict.rationale: Index tuning is a fair question for a vector database, but the evidence pack never documents configurable HNSW parameters, index types, or recall-versus-latency/memory trade-offs. The closest items fall short: the agent-skills mention of quantization guidance is an adjacent helper, not a documented tuning capability, and the create_collection example only sets vector size and distance.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
